description: This C# source file defines the StreamingHistoryGrain class, which implements streaming consumer logic using Orleans framework. It manages subscriptions to streams, handles incoming stream items, and provides mechanisms to retrieve received items and stop consumption.

classes.name: StreamingHistoryGrain
classes.description: A grain class implementing streaming consumer behaviors, managing stream subscriptions, handling stream messages, and exposing received items.

methods.name: BecomeConsumer
methods.description: Subscribes the grain to a specified stream as a consumer.

methods.name: GetReceivedItems
methods.description: Returns the list of items received from the stream.

methods.name: OnNextAsync
methods.description: Handles incoming stream items and adds them to the received items list.
